guardrails.description: Anti-blur guard: generation recipe must include parameters that prevent soft/blurry output. Minimum sharpness threshold enforced at visual QA.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'sharp focus, highly detailed, crisp' to positive prompt; add 'blurry, soft focus, out of focus' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: CFG scale >= 5.0, sampler must support sharp output (e.g. DPM++ 2M Karras), steps >= 30
guardrails.post_processing_guard: add sharpening or detail enhancement node if available
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify sharpness before acceptance

guardrails.description: Anti-softness guard: prevent overall image softness and loss of facial definition.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'sharp facial features, clear definition, high detail face' to positive prompt; add 'soft face, blurry face' to negative prompt
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify facial sharpness

guardrails.description: Realistic eyes guard: eyes must be clean, realistic, with proper iris/pupil detail and no distortion.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'realistic eyes, detailed iris, clean eye shape, natural eye appearance' to positive prompt; add 'deformed eyes, bad eyes, unrealistic eyes, distorted eyes' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: ensure face region is at sufficient resolution (minimum 512x512 face area)
guardrails.post_processing_guard: face detail restoration for eyes recommended
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify eye realism before acceptance

guardrails.description: Clean eyelashes guard: eyelashes must be naturally rendered, not clumped or missing.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'detailed eyelashes, natural eyelashes, clean eyelash detail' to positive prompt; add 'clumpy eyelashes, missing eyelashes, bad eyelashes' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: no specific recipe guard beyond resolution
guardrails.post_processing_guard: face detail enhancement for eye region
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify eyelash quality

guardrails.description: Stable mouth/teeth guard: mouth must be naturally shaped, teeth must be well-formed or mouth closed.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'natural mouth, well-formed teeth, natural smile' to positive prompt; add 'deformed mouth, bad teeth, missing teeth, open mouth distortion' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: consider closed mouth if teeth artifacts persist
guardrails.post_processing_guard: face detail restoration for mouth region
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify mouth/teeth quality

guardrails.description: Visible skin micro-detail guard: skin must have pores, texture, and natural reflectance. No wax/plastic appearance.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'natural skin texture, visible skin pores, realistic skin detail, natural skin reflectance' to positive prompt; add 'smooth skin, plastic skin, wax skin, airbrushed skin, unreal skin' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: CFG scale between 5.0-7.0 (lower reduces smoothing), use detail-oriented sampler
guardrails.post_processing_guard: consider skin detail LoRA or face detail restoration
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify skin has natural micro-detail

guardrails.description: No wax/plastic skin guard: zero tolerance for waxy, plastic-like facial appearance.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'natural skin, realistic skin texture' to positive prompt; add 'wax skin, plastic face, synthetic skin, doll-like skin, mannequin skin' to negative prompt with increased weight
guardrails.recipe_guard: use checkpoint known for natural skin, avoid high CFG (>8.0)
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must reject any waxy/plastic skin appearance

guardrails.description: Hair strand detail guard: hair must have visible individual strands, not rendered as soft blobs.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'detailed hair strands, individual hair strands, sharp hair detail' to positive prompt; add 'soft hair, blurry hair, hair blob, undefined hair' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: ensure sufficient resolution for hair detail
guardrails.post_processing_guard: consider detail enhancement for hair region
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify hair strand detail

guardrails.description: Sharper facial features guard: overall facial features must be sharp and well-defined, not soft.
guardrails.prompt_guard: add 'sharp facial features, well-defined face, crisp face detail' to positive prompt; add 'soft face, undefined features' to negative prompt
guardrails.recipe_guard: use appropriate CFG scale and sampler combination known for sharp output
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must verify facial feature sharpness

guardrails.description: Operator visual review required before production acceptance: no automated production acceptance.
guardrails.enforcement: visual QA must require operator visual review; no production_accepted=true without operator gate
